//: Cold-start budgets for the CI device lane, enforced by tools/check-mobile-perf.mjs (measurement mode; the --closure half runs in the Stop chain and reds a src/routes.ts id with no row here). The lane installs the built APK on the lane emulator and per route runs THREE cold starts (`adb shell am force-stop <pkg>` then `adb shell am start -W <scheme>://<path>`; totalTimeMs is the MEDIAN, coldSamplesMs records every roll) plus ONE warm start (HOME then relaunch; warmTotalTimeMs, capped only by rows that declare maxWarmTotalTimeMs — a warm launch does not always print TotalTime, and a declared-but-unreported cap reds). TotalTime is approximately the logcat Displayed TTID. HONEST LIMIT: fullyDrawnMs stays ABSENT in the managed scaffold by construction — no RN core or Expo SDK module binds Activity.reportFullyDrawn() and injecting native source would break CNG purity — so maxFullyDrawnMs is only for consumers that add a native binding; the median-of-3 cold + warm split is the managed replacement. Budgets are GENEROUS ABSOLUTE MILLISECONDS, deliberately: emulator wall clock on a shared runner is a step-function detector (a sync network call at boot, a blocking module eval), never a drift ratchet — the in-chain perf-budget gate is the tight relative canary. Ratchet down in a reviewed commit once the lane prints real numbers (~4-6x headroom over the observed median). This file is seedOnInitOnly (its rows name THIS project's routes, so `update` never plants the template's rows into a repo with its own screens) and write-guard-protected: raising a cap re-baselines the regression the lane just caught.
